C109.name: Sumbawanga Municipal Council
C109.documented: earthquake on the Rukwa Rift, heavy rain, strong winds, and storm damage to houses

area.sw: Manispaa ya Sumbawanga: mji wa uwanda wa Ufipa

risk.en: This area is a cool, windy plateau town where storm run-off floods valley streets, strong winds damage roofs and the region lies in an active earthquake zone.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa uwandani wenye baridi na upepo ambapo maji ya dhoruba hufurika mitaa ya mabondeni, upepo mkali huharibu paa na mkoa uko katika ukanda hai wa matetemeko.

advice.en: For those living and building here, it helps to keep drains clear, fix roofs firmly and build to earthquake-resistant standards. What raises the risk: building over the valley drains or filling them with waste, leaving roofs loosely fixed on this windy plateau, and putting up heavy unreinforced walls in an earthquake zone. Know the higher street away from the valley that your household will move to when storm water rises; when a strong-wind warning is given, secure roofs and keep children indoors; if the ground shakes, get out into the open away from walls and do not go back in until told. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kujenga hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro wazi, kufunga paa imara na kujenga kwa viwango vinavyostahimili matetemeko. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga juu ya mitaro ya bondeni au kuijaza taka, kuacha paa zisizofungwa imara kwenye uwanda huu wenye upepo, na kujenga kuta nzito zisizoimarishwa katika eneo la matetemeko. Fahamu mtaa wa juu mbali na bonde ambao kaya yako itahamia maji ya dhoruba yanapopanda; tahadhari ya upepo mkali ikitolewa, fungeni paa na waweke watoto ndani; ardhi ikitikisika, tokeni nje uwanjani mbali na kuta na msirudi ndani hadi mtakapoambiwa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C107.name: Kalambo District Council
C107.documented: earthquake, Lake Tanganyika waves and boat accidents, and heavy rain

area.en: Kalambo: Lake Tanganyika escarpment and Kalambo Falls
area.sw: Kalambo: mteremko wa Ziwa Tanganyika na maporomoko ya Kalambo

risk.en: This area runs from the plateau down a steep escarpment to Lake Tanganyika, where landslides cut roads, rivers flash-flood and lake storms endanger fishers.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linaanzia uwandani kushuka mteremko mkali hadi Ziwa Tanganyika, ambapo maporomoko hukata barabara, mito hufurika ghafla na dhoruba za ziwani huhatarisha wavuvi.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to build away from steep slopes and stream banks, wear life jackets and keep food reserves in remote villages. What raises the risk: cutting plots into the escarpment, building on stream banks, setting out on the lake in loaded boats when the sky is building, and letting village food stocks run out before the road closes. Know the firm ground away from the cuts and streams that your household will move to when heavy rain sets in on the escarpment, and the sheltered landing boats will run to when a lake storm builds; restock before the rains, because the road may be cut for weeks. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na miteremko mikali na kingo za vijito, kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa na kuweka akiba ya chakula vijijini vya mbali. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchonga viwanja kwenye mwinuko, kujenga kwenye kingo za vijito, kutoka ziwani kwa vyombo vilivyojaa anga linapojengeka, na kuacha akiba za chakula za kijiji ziishe kabla barabara haijafungwa. Fahamu eneo imara mbali na miinuko na vijito ambalo kaya yako itahamia mvua kubwa inapoanza mwinukoni, na mwalo uliokingwa ambao vyombo vitakimbilia dhoruba ya ziwa inapojengeka; jazeni akiba kabla ya mvua, kwa sababu barabara inaweza kufungwa kwa wiki. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C110.name: Nkasi District Council
C110.documented: earthquake, Lake Tanganyika waves and boat accidents, and shore floods

area.en: Nkasi: Lake Tanganyika shore (Kirando) and plateau
area.sw: Nkasi: ufukwe wa Ziwa Tanganyika (Kirando) na uwanda

risk.en: This area has lakeshore fishing villages such as Kirando exposed to storms and cholera, and plateau farmland where dry spells and strong winds damage crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina vijiji vya wavuvi vya ufukweni kama Kirando vinavyoathiriwa na dhoruba na kipindupindu, na mashamba ya uwandani ambapo vipindi vya ukavu na upepo mkali huharibu mazao.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to wear life jackets, return to shore before storms build and use latrines and safe water. What raises the risk: going out in overloaded or unlit boats, fishing on when clouds build over the lake, drinking untreated lake water and leaving roofs loosely fixed on the plateau. Know the sheltered landing you will run to when a storm builds on the lake, report the first case of watery diarrhoea the same day, and on the plateau agree early where food will come from if the dry spell runs long. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa, kurudi ufukweni kabla dhoruba haijaanza na kutumia vyoo na maji salama. Kinachoongeza hatari: kutoka ziwani kwa vyombo vilivyojaa kupita kiasi au visivyo na taa, kuendelea kuvua mawingu yanapojengeka juu ya ziwa, kunywa maji ya ziwa yasiyotibiwa na kuacha paa zisizofungwa imara uwandani. Fahamu mwalo uliokingwa utakaokimbilia dhoruba inapojengeka ziwani, ripoti mgonjwa wa kwanza wa kuharisha maji siku hiyo hiyo, na uwandani kubalianeni mapema chakula kitatoka wapi kiangazi kikirefuka. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C108.name: Sumbawanga District Council
C108.documented: earthquake, heavy rain, strong winds, and floods toward Lake Rukwa

area.en: Sumbawanga DC: Lake Rukwa basin and plateau farms
area.sw: Sumbawanga DC: bonde la Ziwa Rukwa na mashamba ya uwandani

risk.en: This area has the hot Lake Rukwa basin, where the lake spreads over farms and villages in wet years, and plateau farms where hail and dry spells damage maize.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina bonde la joto la Ziwa Rukwa, ambapo ziwa hutanuka na kufunika mashamba na vijiji katika miaka ya mvua nyingi, na mashamba ya uwandani ambapo mvua ya mawe na ukavu huharibu mahindi.

advice.en: For those farming and fishing here, it helps to keep homes above the lake flood line, use the flood plain seasonally and keep household food reserves. What raises the risk and to the loss in a dry year: building permanent houses and stores on the lake flats, staying on the low ground while the lake is still rising, and relying on one crop on the plateau. Know the raised ground and the dry route to it that your village will use when Lake Rukwa spreads, and move people, stores and animals there as soon as the lake begins to rise, not after the fields are under water. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kujenga juu ya mstari wa mafuriko ya ziwa, kutumia tambarare kwa msimu na kuweka akiba ya chakula ya kaya. Kinachoongeza hatari na hasara mwaka wa ukame: kujenga nyumba na maghala ya kudumu kwenye tambarare za ziwa, kubaki kwenye ardhi ya chini ziwa likiwa bado linapanda, na kutegemea zao moja uwandani. Fahamu eneo lililoinuka na njia kavu ya kufika huko ambayo kijiji chenu kitatumia Ziwa Rukwa linapotapakaa, na hamisheni watu, akiba na mifugo huko mara ziwa linapoanza kupanda, si baada ya mashamba kuzama. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
